STEP 6. Check passenger's door switch connector D-01 
and ETACS-ECU connectors C-111 and C-114 for damage. 
Q: Are front passenger's door switch connector D-01 and 
ETACS-ECU connectors C-111 and C-114 in good 
condition?
YES : Go to Step 7.
NO : Repair or replace them. Refer to GROUP 00E, 
Harness Connector Inspection P.00E-2. The 
passenger's door switch input signal should be able to 
be checked and the functions, which are described in 
the "Technical Description (comment)," should work 
normally.
